recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The seed issue is already applied in current core source; future changes to Immunization status vocabulary should come from a new PHER/workflow decision rather than replaying the 2015 wording literally.
issue_request: FHIR-7867 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 PHER change request asking to add a record status to Immunization to communicate active, in error, and cancelled. The recorded 2015-07-02 PHER resolution agreed to add status and work on vocabulary.
initial_application: Git commit b4d544060a explicitly applied #7867 by adding Immunization.status as a required modifier code with a required status binding, summary flag, statusCode mapping, committee note #7867, and example status values. The current source still carries the #7867 committee note on Immunization.status.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini. Later workflow/event alignment changed the concrete Immunization status vocabulary from the 2015 draft wording to completed, entered-in-error, and not-done. FHIR-54325 later refined statusReason around not-done and entered-in-error and is already represented on the combined branch. A 2022 Zulip workflow thread also describes Immunization statuses as limited to completed, entered-in-error, and not-done for point-in-time immunization events.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active Immunization definition has a required modifier Immunization.status element bound to the Immunization Status Codes value set, the value set includes completed, entered-in-error, and not-done, a status search parameter exists, and examples carry status values. Reintroducing active/cancelled as literal codes would conflict with later vocabulary and event-pattern decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied PHER issue refined Immunization.statusReason for not-done and entered-in-error and is already represented on the combined branch.
